title: TransactionEditView still uses /api/collections/transactions/{id}
body: src/ui/admin/TransactionEditView/index.tsx:693 fetches `/api/collections/transactions/${id}?depth=2` directly. If this pattern was also broken (404), the same fix would be needed — adding a dedicated endpoint or using MetricsProvider for single-transaction view. However, this was not reported in the bug, so may be working fine (e.g., GET on specific ID may be permitted while list is blocked).
rationale: Consistency — if /api/collections/transactions returns 404 for the list endpoint, the single-ID fetch may have the same issue.

title: CouponUsageModal uses /api/collections/transactions
body: src/ui/admin/Coupons/CouponUsageModal/index.tsx:319 uses `/admin/collections/transactions/${transactionId}` for an href (not a fetch), which is fine since it links to the admin panel UI, not the REST API. No action needed.
rationale: No bug reported for this component — it's a link, not a fetch call.
